beats.headline: A coupon with a flexed arm
beats.text: Among the prizes on the table sits a piece of paper printed with a buff, flexed arm: a mercenary coupon, good for 100,000 gold of mercenary services at any participating Meat Shields location. Crawler Carl asks what Meat Shields is. Mordecai shrugs. Probably the name of the mercenary markets on this floor: there is one in the Desperado and one in Club Vanquisher, and there was probably one in Larracos too. Which reminds him that the guildhall needs a mercenary training arcade.

beats.headline: Across from the jeweler
beats.text: Deep in the club, down a side hallway on the far side of the badger bar, a gnome jeweler and a few odds and ends on one side, and on the other, a Meat Shields location where one can purchase mercenaries. Crawler Carl and Crawler Donut both hold coupons for it. They are saving them. Carl walks past. He is here tonight on other business.

beats.headline: The home office
beats.text: Damascus has an offer. The whole crew of the Penis Parade still holds Meat Shields memberships, and Crawler Carl holds a coupon: hire them on a two-floor contract, and they can leave with him. He calls over an elderly dwarf with a fuzzy mole named Bernie on her shoulder. Rosemarie manages the top floor's Meat Shields location. Carl did not know there was one; it is not on his map. I work out of my home office, she says, waving at where her table used to be. There is a hole there now.

beats.headline: The end of an era
beats.text: Rosemarie does not want to lose her dancers. Without them the place fills with dregs, and nobody hires an elderly stripper with one leg and halitosis. Damascus says a restructuring is coming, his mother dead, the crew thrown to the Larracos level Meat Shields otherwise. The price is the coupon, 100,000 gold. Damascus stays behind. Rosemarie calls it the end of an era, opens her shop interface, and asks to see the coupon. Thirteen dancers, a skeleton DJ and Bucket Boy report to Carl's barracks.

beats.headline: How the Parade hid
beats.text: Crawler Carl's theory, offered to Katia as a theory: when Astrid became assistant manager of the club, she got her two sons a job at the Penis Parade where she could watch over them. They were all Meat Shields members, and they brought their friends. She parked Rosemarie in there, so the dancers were technically still mercenaries, and since nobody knew the club was also a Meat Shields location, they were safe. Only the men of the Penis Parade were eligible to be hired.

beats.headline: Airlocked to the markets
beats.text: On the way down through Larracos, the city's own mercenary markets are still flooded out and ruined. Further down, the Desperado Club reopens under a new manager who admits no crawlers and wants no visitors. Clarabelle is lucky to have kept her job. Everybody else was not so lucky: the surviving cretins and sai were airlocked out and sent off to the mercenary markets.

beats.headline: Quickly snatched up
beats.text: The System files the career of one of those survivors. A level-70 Sai mercenary leader lost his entire squad in an incident at the Desperado Club for which Crawler Carl may or may not be partially responsible. In the reorganisation the few Sai survivors were relegated to the mercenary markets, where he was quickly snatched up. Crawler Carl inherits the contract by defeating his employer. The System doubts this has done much for his self-esteem.

beats.headline: Storage, or back to the market
beats.text: Ninth floor, closing arrangements. Nobody is certain what happens to the mercenaries. The hired ones, the Sledge and the other surviving cretins among them, along with the dungeon-born mercenaries for hire on every team, are expected to simply disappear: possibly into storage for the next crawl, possibly tossed back into the mercenary market. They do not go down to the twelfth floor. The strippers are a question mark, and so they stay with the crawlers.

beats.headline: Returned for cause
beats.text: Bucket Boy sees a Taurin among a group of dancers and knows him at once. His name is Pontiff. He was a dancer, and Damascus sent him back to the mercenary market because he was a dick. Bucket Boy's evidence: Pontiff once slapped him for getting in the way during a routine, in a club with almost nobody in it.

beats.headline: Prices are double
beats.text: Race preparations. Rosetta sends word that she and Tipid are already in town at the mercenary market, and asks what Crawler Carl needs. A driver and defence, he says, fast reflexes, at least two who can drive, since neither he nor Donut can take the next race. Nobody too crazy. Prices are double, Rosetta warns, because Carl lost the last two mercenaries they hired. Get the best you can, says Carl.
